$comment: Known, tracked divergences between prisma/schema.prisma and the live database.
scripts/ci/check-db-live-drift.ts fails on any drift NOT listed here, so this file is
the reviewed record of what we are knowingly carrying and until when.
Every entry needs an owner, a reason, and an `expires` date. Past the expiry the
guard fails anyway — an allowlist without an expiry is just a permanently
disabled check, which is how the ledger reconciler ended up ignored.
Remove an entry the moment its fix lands. Do not add one to make CI green.
TWO LISTS, because tolerating a divergence and permitting its removal are not the
`destructiveStatementsAllowed` — a statement a reconcile push MAY run.
`npm run db:preflight` refuses a plan containing anything else that destroys
`knownDivergences` — a divergence the live database carries that must NOT be
dropped yet. The drift check tolerates these; the preflight does NOT. The
pre-#2257 support-ticket tables are here because `origin/prod` still queries
them, so a push that dropped them would break production. Move an entry to
`destructiveStatementsAllowed` when its removal is safe, push, then empty both.
Entries are exact `prisma migrate diff --script` statements, whitespace-insensitive.
